defect.cause: BindToClose freezes only current sessions, but PlayerRemoving can backfill a queued fifth player and a pending read/claim can complete after shutdown starts. Late sessions are absent from the shutdown final-save set.
defect.reproduction: Full canonical server: start slow final saves, remove a player while BindToClose is suspended; pinned main admits waiting fifth player. Pending GetAsync also admits after shutdown. No real-world incident frequency measured.

fix: Fence new admissions before shutdown saves. Check fence at join entry and all pending GetAsync/UpdateAsync continuation points, releasing an already-committed token through existing CAS. Keep normal backfill before shutdown and existing final-save concurrency.
character_impact: Existing three toy stats/prices/models, three-button selector, waiting notice, guide and save schema unchanged.
next_action: Exact-head offline+compile_hold, then independent REVIEWER and post-merge main QA. No owner approval needed.
